readings: For each `transref` in `sentimentandfundamentals`, calculate the average non-null `anlycount`. Calculate the overall average of those per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose average is null, and keep only transactions above it. For each kept transaction, show `transref`, its per-transaction average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the unweighted average of the per-transaction averages of all kept transactions. Sort by the last difference descending, with nulls last. Return the first 10 rows and all rows tied with the 10th. Do not round.

For each `transref` in `sentimentandfundamentals`, calculate the average non-null `anlycount`. Calculate the overall average of those per-transaction averages, excluding transactions whose average is null, and keep only transactions above it. For each kept transaction, show `transref`, its per-transaction average, its difference from the overall average, and its difference from the average of all non-null `anlycount` values in rows belonging to kept transactions, pooling those rows together. Sort by the last difference descending, with nulls last. Return the first 10 rows and all rows tied with the 10th. Do not round.
queries:
WITH per_transaction AS (
    SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS transaction_avg
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(transaction_avg) AS overall_avg
    FROM per_transaction
    WHERE transaction_avg IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.transref, p.transaction_avg, o.overall_avg
    FROM per_transaction AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.transaction_avg > o.overall_avg
),
differences AS (
    SELECT
        transref,
        transaction_avg,
        transaction_avg - overall_avg AS overall_difference,
        transaction_avg - AVG(transaction_avg) OVER () AS kept_difference
    FROM kept
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY kept_difference DESC NULLS LAST) AS row_rank
    FROM differences
)
SELECT transref, transaction_avg, overall_difference, kept_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE row_rank <= 10
ORDER BY kept_difference DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS transaction_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(transaction_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.transaction_avg, o.overall_avg
  FROM per_transaction AS p
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE p.transaction_avg > o.overall_avg
),
pooled AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.anlycount) AS pooled_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN kept AS k ON s.transref = k.transref
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    k.transref,
    k.transaction_avg,
    k.transaction_avg - k.overall_avg AS overall_difference,
    k.transaction_avg - p.pooled_avg AS pooled_difference,
    RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY k.transaction_avg - p.pooled_avg DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS row_rank
  FROM kept AS k
  CROSS JOIN pooled AS p
)
SELECT transref, transaction_avg, overall_difference, pooled_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE row_rank <= 10
ORDER BY pooled_difference DESC NULLS LAST
